column1: # ZAP baseline rules tweak. One rule per line, tab-separated:
# Justifications below — ignore items that don't apply to a JSON API behind cookie auth.

column3: Information disclosure - suspicious comments (false positives in JS bundles)
Cookie without SameSite (handled — sameSite=strict for our auth cookie)
Permissions-Policy header — set by helmet defaults
Timestamp disclosure - we expose uptime in /api/health intentionally
Absence of Anti-CSRF tokens on forms — we use double-submit cookie
Reflected XSS — keep as warning to catch regressions
Insufficient Site Isolation — handled by helmet COOP/CORP
